name: agent-screen
title: Agent Screen
summary: A live view of the screen an agent is working on, with its cursor.
description: Watch an agent work: a framed capture of its screen with the agent's cursor and a recording badge. Pass the capture as `src`; without one the frame draws a neutral placeholder window from tokens. The cursor glides to each new position on a transform (it jumps under reduced motion), the frame carries a text alternative, and every change of state is announced through a role=status region.

anatomy.description: role=img with the text alternative (alt, else the label); 16:10, clips its layers
The capture (src), covering the frame; alt is empty, the frame names it
Neutral window drawn from tokens when there is no src
Layer as large as the frame, translated by --fndn-agent-screen-cursor ("x%, y%"); holds the pointer icon at its top-left
Spinner and text, shown while data-state=loading
Visible caption; truncates, full text in title
expandable: a Button (outline, xs, square, rounded) on the frame's bottom end corner, with our tooltip (labels.expand) and aria-haspopup=dialog; opens the viewer Marked data-agent-screen="expand".
expandable: the body of our dialog (size lg, title = the label): the same frame, larger, with the root's data-state and data-recording.

state.description: loading: connecting (spinner). live: the agent works; its cursor shows. idle: the screen stays, the cursor hides.

cursor.description: { x, y } in percent of the screen, clamped to 0–100. Set on the cursor layer as "x%, y%". Defaults to { x: 42, y: 53 }.

recording.description: Shows the REC badge and adds "Recording" to the status.

label.description: Caption under the frame; also starts the status text.

alt.description: Text alternative of the frame. Defaults to the label; describe the capture when you pass src.

src.description: Image URL of the agent's screen. Without it the placeholder is drawn.

labels.description: Status words, badge and button: loading, live, idle, recording, rec, expand.

expandable.description: Adds a button with a tooltip on the frame's corner that opens the screen larger in our dialog.

a11y.role: figure with an img frame and a status region
keyboard: The screen itself takes no focus
expandable: Tab reaches the expand button; Enter / Space open the viewer dialog (focus moves into it); Escape or the close button close it and focus returns to the button
notes: The frame is role=img with an accessible name; pass alt to describe a real capture.
Changes of state and recording are announced through role=status; the cursor's moves are not announced.
expandable: the button is named (labels.expand) and shows our tooltip; the viewer is our dialog, named by the label, with its focus trap, Escape and focus return.

motion: cursor: transform over duration.slow with easing.in-out-strong (on-screen travel); under reduced motion it jumps, the show/hide fade stays
cursor show/hide and connecting overlay: opacity over duration.base
REC badge: opacity + scale from motion.popup-scale out of its top right corner (where it is pinned) over duration.popup with easing.out-strong; leaves over duration.fast
REC dot: opacity loop (1.1s), kept under reduced motion
viewer: our dialog's motion (scale from motion.popup-scale and the scrim fade); the cursor glides in the viewer too
